preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access onlyOwner functions

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call multipleBotlistAddress() function with target victim addresses and set excluded=true to blacklist them. This will prevent any transfers to or from blacklisted addresses via the _transfer() function's require(!_isBlacklisted[sender] && !_isBlacklisted[recipient]) check. The owner can arbitrarily freeze any user's tokens by blacklisting their address, effectively locking their funds.
